messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy blocked for release 2026.03.18-rc2 -> prod: env-parity check failed. ConfigMap 'feature-flags' key case mismatch detected (PROD: SERVICE_FLAG, STAGING: service_flag). Canary paused. Please investigate.

maria: Wait, we renamed that key during the frontend refactor last week, I thought we added a compatibility alias?

jon: Checking helm overlays + kustomize now. give me a sec.

sre-liz: Paste of quick checks:
```
# prod
kubectl -n prod get cm feature-flags -o yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: feature-flags
data:
  SERVICE_FLAG: "true"
  beta_ui: "enabled"
# staging
kubectl -n staging get cm feature-flags -o yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: feature-flags
data:
  service_flag: "true"
  beta_ui: "enabled"
```

ops-bot: Also detected: KMS key mismatch for secrets/service-credentials between staging and prod (prod -> projects/redwood-prod/keys/prod-kms, staging -> projects/redwood-staging/keys/staging-kms). Not blocking but worth noting.

rachael: That case mismatch explains the canary failures. Our config-template maps ConfigMap keys into env vars case-sensitively, so prod ends up with APP_FEATURE_SERVICE_FLAG and staging gets APP_FEATURE_service_flag which the app doesn't read.

maria: Recommendation: hold the full rollout. Quick mitigation options: 1) add lowercase alias (service_flag) to prod CM, 2) update template to map both keys, or 3) roll back frontend to previous behavior. Prefer 1 for minimal blast radius.

jon: I can push a one-line patch to prod CM to add service_flag alias with same value. Will open a hotfix PR and apply with kubectl apply -f - (manual approval required).

sre-liz: If we patch prod, we should also update the helm chart and kustomize overlays to keep parity. I'll file a follow-up ticket and add to next sprint.

maria: Change window note: we can do the patch now but schedule the canary restart inside the 30-minute change window starting in 20m. @jon please coordinate.

jon: On it. Hotfix branch created: gitlab.com/redwood/release/rc2-hotfix-configmap-alias. Applying patch now.

deploy-bot: Action required: manual approval to apply hotfix to prod. Use /deploy approve 1943210000-hotfix to proceed.

rachael: Also flagging release notes: add line under "Known issues" — env parity: feature flag key case mismatch between staging/prod; hotfix applied.

ops-bot: NOTE: I created incident-refs/INC-20260318-09 for the KMS key divergence and marked as low-severity.

maria: Decision summary: HOLD release until hotfix applied and canary validated. Patch prod CM to include lowercase alias, update helm overlays to normalize key names, update release notes and chore ticket for full parity.

jon: Patch applied (kubectl -n prod apply -f -), waiting for rollout. Logs: deployment/frontend: rolling update triggered, pods restarting.

sre-liz: Observing pods -> new pods have env APP_FEATURE_service_flag=true and APP_FEATURE_SERVICE_FLAG=true. healthchecks passing.

deploy-bot: Canary status: paused -> ready. Manual resume required. Use /deploy resume 1943210000 to continue.

maria: I'll wait for one successful canary cycle (~5m) then we resume full rollout. thumbs. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up tasks created: TKT-4583 (helm overlay normalization), TKT-4584 (audit env-parity runbook).

rachael: Good catch, thanks team. Will update the release notes and announce the hold in the release channel.

deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.18-rc2 -> status: BLOCKED -> HOTFIX_APPLIED -> AWAITING_MANUAL_RESUME.
